facts.name: Dahlia
facts.light: Sun to part shade; rich, moist, well-drained soil
facts.notes: Big, showy flowers from midsummer until frost, in almost every color, and great for cutting. Not winter-hardy here: dig the tubers after the first frost and replant them in May.
facts.toxSrc: ASPCA lists it as toxic to dogs and cats; NC State notes low-severity poison
